hooks.name: security-bandit-on-save
hooks.description: After the agent saves or creates a file in the response, AI, explanation, threat or core packages, run bandit -ll on it. Read-only.

hooks.name: security-boundary-review
hooks.description: Ask the agent to check the security boundaries after it creates or changes a security-sensitive backend file. Report only.

action.prompt: A security-sensitive backend file (response, AI, explanation, threat or core package) was just created or changed. Check the change and report any violation: (1) every response action still passes through ResponseGuard and is carried out only by SimulatedActionExecutor; (2) no subprocess, os.system or os.popen call uses user- or AI-influenced arguments; (3) AI output is validated by AIOutputValidator before storage or display and never reaches threat scoring, the defense state machine, ResponsePlanner, ResponseGuard or the executor; (4) the protected files backend/response/guard.py, backend/ai/validator.py, backend/threat/scorer.py, backend/threat/state_machine.py, backend/response/planner.py and backend/response/executor.py were not modified without Henok's explicit approval. Report findings only: do not edit any file in response to this hook.
